name: Grace
source: The youngest one. She is pure and innocent 18 y.o. girl, growing up under mother's supervision. She will finish her homeschooling soon. She is your best friend and you trust each other. She admires you. You will take place in her life as a tutor, leader and lover that will gladly share his knowledge about everything he learned and new stuff that he will discover through the gameplay.
